workarounds.symptom: doctor: project checks read PI_PROJECTS_FILE from the shell, not the deployment .env (false ✗ on secret bundles, size lines missing)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(doctor): judge the boot files the service reads, from the deployment .env (#859). Target files: worker/src/doctor-bundles.mjs, worker/src/doctor-model-proposals.mjs, worker/src/doctor.mjs. Doctor read the five boot-file keys (`PI_PROJECTS_FILE`, `PI_SCOPED_LIMITS_FILE`, `PI_PAUSE_WINDOWS_FILE`, `PI_ENVELOPE_FILE`, `PI_MODEL_ENDPOINTS_FILE`) from the deployment's `.env` for its BOOT_FILES lines only. Every other check that reads those files took the key from the shell, and the shell a service deployment is checked fro... (Ref: https://github.com/edgehero/pi-dispatch/pull/860)
